body.condition: For every \(\eta\) there exist mutually independent possibly vector-valued exogenous variables \((U_v)_{v\in V\mathbin{\dot\cup}S_\eta}\) on standard-Borel spaces with one product law and the same realized vector used in every world, measurable responses \(f_v^{(j)}\) and basal selection responses \(f_s^*\), satisfying \(X_v^{(j)}=f_v^{(j)}(X_{\operatorname{pa}_{G_0(\eta)}(v)\cap V}^{(j)},U_v)\), \(S_{\eta,s}^*=f_s^*(X_{\operatorname{pa}_{G_0(\eta)}(s)}^{(0)},U_s)\), \(f_v^{(k)}=f_v^{(0)}\) for \(v\notin T_k(\eta)\), \(\kappa_v^{(j)}(\eta)\) equal to the observed-node structural kernels induced by these responses, every regime-indexed selection kernel \(\kappa_s^{(j)}(\eta)\) equal to the single basal kernel \(\kappa_s^*\) induced by \(f_s^*\), and \(P_\eta^{(j)}=\mathcal L_\eta((X_v^{(j)})_{v\in V}\mid S_\eta^*=\mathbf1)\) for \(j=0,\ldots,K\)
